feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以准确监测donanemab治疗后的淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，ARIA发生率7.87%，停药主因经济负担。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样蛋白治疗入组标准。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促认知药多数疗效有限，亟需优化靶点与试验设计。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强AD多靶点抑制活性，为MTDLs设计提供构效依据。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗疗效与安全性异质性显著，早期AD获益风险比不支持类效应。

mech.title: Long-term safety and immunogenicity of ABvac40 active immunotherapy in mild cognitive impairment and very mild Alzheimer's disease: Results from AB1601 phase 2 extension study.
mech.zh: ABvac40延迟加强接种维持长期安全性并诱导免疫记忆，支持其持续开发。

mech.title: The Possible Association Between Bisphenol A (BPA) and the Neuropathological Processes Characteristic of Alzheimer's Disease-A Systematic Review of the Literature.
mech.zh: 系统综述提示双酚A暴露或与阿尔茨海默病神经病理过程相关。

mech.title: CellSwarm-AD: A Multi-Scale Agent-Based Framework for Virtual Alzheimer's Disease Trials.
mech.zh: CellSwarm-AD提出四层多尺度智能体框架，实现AD病理级联与虚拟临床试验全流程可复现模拟。

mech.title: Metabolism Pathway Blood Proteomic Differences in Lewy Body Dementia Compared to Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: DLB与AD及对照存在代谢相关血清蛋白差异，SERPINB8或为鉴别诊断候选标志物。

mech.title: 2-(Arylamino)thiazol-4(5H)-ones Mitigate Oxidative Stress and Confer Neuroprotection in Cellular and Drosophila Models of Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 新型噻唑酮类化合物3n可减轻氧化应激并改善阿尔茨海默病模型的行为缺陷。

mech.title: Plant Polysaccharides in Alzheimer's Disease: From Phytochemistry to Microbiota-Gut-Brain Axis Mechanisms-Resolving the Pharmacokinetic-Pharmacodynamic Paradox.
mech.zh: 中药多糖借肠脑轴调控神经炎症，破解低生物利用度与药效矛盾。

mech.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 木脂素类化合物通过多靶点机制（抑制Aβ聚集、抗炎抗氧化等）治疗阿尔茨海默病，且其活性呈骨架依赖性。

mech.title: Gut Microbiome Changes in Preclinical Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 临床前阿尔茨海默病阶段已出现肠道菌群及短链脂肪酸代谢的早期改变。

dx.title: From clinical phenotypes to molecular precision: multimodal biomarkers for progressive supranuclear palsy.
dx.zh: 多模态生物标志物可精准识别PSP分子亚型，突破临床表型重叠局限。

dx.title: Neurobiological markers across joint profiles of subjective cognitive decline and objective cognitive function in older adults.
dx.zh: 主观认知下降与客观认知功能不一致的老年人，其神经损伤及脑老化标志物水平存在显著差异。

dx.title: Electrochemical profiling of plasma pTau-181 levels associated with mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease using an MXene-gold nanorod interface.
dx.zh: MXene-金纳米棒界面电化学传感可灵敏检测血浆pTau-181，助力AD及MCI早期诊断。

dx.title: Semantic fluency predicts survival of memory clinic patients.
dx.zh: 语义流畅性可预测记忆门诊患者生存期，且独立于淀粉样蛋白及神经退行性影像标志物。

dx.title: Concordance between plasma biomarkers of phosphorylated tau and tau-PET: A narrative review.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau与tau-PET阳性一致性随疾病阶段及标志物类型而异，且p-tau231先于p-tau217出现。

dx.title: Interactive Effects of Plasma Alzheimer Disease Biomarkers and White Matter Hyperintensities on Cognitive Decline and Clinical Progression in Nondemented Adults.
dx.journal: Journal of the American Heart Associatio
dx.zh: 血浆AD生物标志物与白质高信号交互加速认知衰退及痴呆进展。

dx.title: Ultrasensitive detection of blood-based p-tau217 for Alzheimer's disease integrated antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates and RCA/Cas12a system.
dx.zh: 基于抗体-寡核苷酸偶联物与RCA/Cas12a系统，实现血液p-tau217超灵敏检测，灵敏度达1 fg/mL。

dx.title: Valine modulates Alzheimer's disease risk in APOE ε4 carriers: evidence from two cohorts.
dx.zh: 缬氨酸可调节APOE ε4携带者的阿尔茨海默病风险，或为干预靶点。

prev.title: Risk factors and cognitive domain markers of progression in subjective cognitive decline.
prev.zh: 主观认知下降进展者基线即存在特定认知域缺陷及血管风险因素。

prev.title: Risk of depression after new-onset dementia or cognitive impairment: the Health and Retirement Study.
prev.zh: 新发痴呆或认知障碍者后续抑郁风险显著升高。

prev.title: Natural History and Clinical Associations of Plasma Interleukin-6 Levels in Traumatic Brain Injury.
prev.zh: 血浆IL-6在脑外伤后呈动态变化，其慢性期升高与不良神经功能预后独立相关。

prev.title: Probing effect modification by socioeconomic status in associations between blood biomarkers of neuropathology and cognitive outcomes in the United States and India.
prev.zh: 美印两国数据显示，社会经济地位显著调节血液神经病理标志物与认知结局的关联强度。

prev.title: Risk factors and hospital harm: A study of hip fracture patients in the community using population-based data.
prev.zh: 社区髋部骨折老人住院伤害与个体及社区层面风险因素显著相关。

prev.title: Mapping the Synaptome in Neurodegeneration: Emerging Clinical Applications of SV2A PET Imaging.
prev.zh: SV2A PET成像可活体量化突触丢失，有望成为神经退行性疾病的通用生物标志物。

prev.title: Combined social determinants of health, mortality, and adverse health outcomes in early natural menopause.
prev.zh: 早期自然绝经女性中，社会健康决定因素越不利，死亡及痴呆等不良结局风险越高。

prev.title: A Narrative Review: Suvorexant's Role in Sleep Deprivation and Neurodegenerative Disease.
prev.zh: 综述提示苏沃雷沙改善睡眠，或延缓AD/PD神经退行进程。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是植物里的木脂素成分，能多管齐下对付老年痴呆的几个关键毛病，帮普通人看懂以后吃啥、防啥。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 人老了脑子生病，可能跟平时吃的东西有关，吃对了也许能帮着护住脑子，延缓记性变差。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 抽血查老年痴呆越来越准了，但光靠化验单还不够，得先想清楚查完怎么用，不然对普通人可能帮倒忙。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是免疫细胞上的一个“开关”蛋白TREM2，它在脑瘤和老年痴呆里作用相反，看懂它有助于未来开发更精准的免疫治疗。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、动作变慢，看懂它就能明白为啥老人容易得痴呆，也好提前留意。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家在找能管住大脑里两种“捣乱酶”的药，用来缓解老年痴呆症状，帮病人多留住一些记忆和自理能力。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述想告诉你，老年痴呆可能和大脑“吃不饱饭”有关，了解这点，或许能帮我们更早预防和干预。

intro.title: Discovery of Anti-Neuroinflammatory Compounds in Alzheimer's Disease: Current Trends and Future Perspectives.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正尝试用消炎药来缓解大脑发炎，从而延缓老年痴呆，给未来新药研发指了条新路。
